title: A Cellar for the Portrait
author: Theo Coldharbour
blurb: Sable Whitlock, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
